preregistration.prior_evidence: EXP-0091 accepted the exact null-LvProp Alpha image without repair, but did not establish null-LvProp acceptance for arbitrary schemas. EXP-0093 observed the exact IdxTri three-index schema with a non-null external LvProp. EXP-0105 observed the exact 70-field ContOneX schema with a continuation at page 68 and did not establish arbitrary continuation placement. PR #176 composes indexed null-LvProp candidates but refuses continuations; PR #177 adds publication without adding DAO evidence.
preregistration.hypothesis_source: Issue #178 proposes the smallest bounded discriminator for both open evidence gaps: compare the accepted Alpha null-LvProp control, an exact EXP-0093 schema composed with null LvProp, and an exact EXP-0105 one-continuation schema composed with compact page-23 placement against fresh same-schema DAO controls.
preregistration.authorization: Acquisition is forbidden until this exact plan, candidate source manifest, and every SHA-256-pinned input are reviewed, committed, and merged. A human must then explicitly authorize the one allowed local-VM dispatch.
preregistration.attempt_policy: Copy and identity-check every candidate replica before the first DAO mutation. Dispatch one three-replica run only. Once the first DAO CreateDatabase begins, any failure is a scientific result and must not be retried without another explicit human decision.

candidate_invariants.shared: Each candidate contains one empty user table, a physically null catalog LvProp, and the retained empty mapped first-create LVAL page. Every candidate is generated deterministically from the manifest-pinned Rust source and checked through the project reader before its identity is admitted.
candidate_invariants.alpha: The exact 23-page EXP-0091 accepted Alpha(Id Long) image is the positive candidate gate.
candidate_invariants.indexed: The 26-page IdxTri candidate has Long fields Id, Code, and Sequence; physical indexes ZPrimary(Id ascending primary unique required), MUniqueX(Code descending unique), and ASecondx(Sequence ascending ordinary); and the EXP-0093 page order with roots 23 through 25.
candidate_invariants.wide: The 24-page ContOneX candidate has the exact 70 Long field names from EXP-0105, a 2075-byte definition, and one test-only continuation placed at page 23 with root 20 pointing to it. This compact placement is the preregistered hypothesis, not an admitted allocation rule.

execution.environment: The private local Windows development VM documented in docs/LOCAL_WINDOWS_VM.md, using x86 Windows PowerShell and DAO.DBEngine.36.
execution.pre_mutation: Generate the three candidates from manifest-pinned Rust source, stage and identity-check them, then copy and identity-check all nine candidate replicas before creating the first DAO control.
execution.per_replica: Create and close fresh DAO Jet 3 controls for Alpha, IdxTri, and ContOneX; then read the three pinned candidate copies and three controls through the same bounded endpoint sequence. Candidate opens are read-only. Record size and SHA-256 immediately before and after endpoint reads.

endpoints: TableDefs is exactly the expected user table plus the four expected system tables
the user TableDef resolves by name
all fields enumerate with exact names, order, and Long type
all indexes enumerate with exact names, flags, key names, and directions after name normalization
the Tables document resolves by name and the document inventory is exact

questions.alpha: Does the exact EXP-0091 null-LvProp Alpha candidate still pass unchanged with the expected fresh-control semantics in all replicas?
questions.indexed: Does DAO read the exact null-LvProp IdxTri candidate unchanged with the same bounded schema semantics as fresh DAO IdxTri controls in all replicas?
questions.wide: Does DAO read the exact null-LvProp ContOneX candidate with compact page-23 continuation placement unchanged with the same bounded schema semantics as fresh DAO ContOneX controls in all replicas?

decision_rule.observed_accepted: All three same-schema controls pass unchanged with exact replicated semantics, and all three selected candidates pass unchanged with the same semantics.
decision_rule.not_observed_accepted: All three same-schema controls pass unchanged, while all three selected candidates either stop at the same endpoint with identical bounded observations or complete unchanged with the same semantic mismatch.
decision_rule.no_outcome: Use when a control fails or changes, Alpha is not observed accepted, an image changes, replicas disagree, the scientific job is incomplete, or observations cannot be classified under the two rules above.
decision_rule.validation_rejection: Reject without a report for any malformed plan or result, pin or retained-identity mismatch, pre-mutation failure, inventory or bound violation, or unexpected file.
decision_rule.report_status: accepted only when Alpha is observed_accepted and both indexed and wide are either observed_accepted or not_observed_accepted; otherwise no_outcome.

evidence_boundary.establishes_only: A replicated read-only DAO observation for each exact candidate identity and schema, including whether DAO consumes the exact compact continuation candidate without repair.
not_claimed: a general property payload or continuation-allocation grammar
permission to omit the retained LVAL page or its map reference
hosted write-differential evidence, general compatibility, or support-matrix movement

retention.publish: environment.json, result.json, the bounded job result, up to eighteen exact-name MDBs including bounded post-mutation recovery artifacts, and the deterministic analyzer report.
retention.repository: Never commit MDB bytes or provider binaries. Record the validated report identity and conclusions once as one additive EXP outcome.
